rules: Read the CacheKit master key from the CACHEKIT_MASTER_KEY environment variable or a secret manager. Never hard-code a key in source, not even a placeholder such as [0u8; 32].
`CACHEKIT_MASTER_KEY` holds the key as a hex string. Use exactly 32 bytes (64 hex characters), for example from `openssl rand -hex 32`: it is the only length every CacheKit SDK accepts.

Install the official packages: `cachekit` on PyPI, `@cachekit-io/cachekit` on npm, and `cachekit-rs` on crates.io (imported as `cachekit`). The crates.io crate named `cachekit` is an unrelated project.
The hosted backend is CacheKit Cloud. In code it is named `CachekitIO` (in Python, `CachekitIOBackend`).
Applications normally use a CacheKit SDK. cachekit-core is the shared byte-storage and encryption layer underneath them.
